info.title: TutorPilot Universal External AI Agent API
info.description: Strictly scoped API allowing any external AI platform (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Make, Zapier, n8n, or custom agents) to perform the exact 3 declared capabilities of TutorPilot My Agent: (1) End-of-class student progress updates (Last Taught & Next to Teach), (2) Calendar & schedule management, and (3) TutorPilot website help. Destructive operations, student creation/deletion, course mutations, and private guardian PII access are blocked at the server layer.

get.summary: Read today's classes and students overview, or retrieve the TutorPilot App Help Guide
get.description: Pass action=overview to get today's scheduled students, what to teach next, and read-only course lesson titles (PII scrubbed). Pass action=guide to retrieve how TutorPilot features work.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Select 'overview' for today's students and syllabus outlines, or 'guide' for TutorPilot website instructions.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Optional app help topic when action=guide (e.g. courses, students, schedule, settings).

200.description: Requested overview or app guide returned successfully

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token

403.description: Capability disabled by tutor or undeclared action blocked

post.summary: Execute one of the 3 declared TutorPilot capabilities
post.description: Strictly allowlisted endpoint for (1) log_after_class_update / get_overview, (2) schedule_lesson / cancel_lesson, and (3) get_app_guide. Any undeclared action returns HTTP 403.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token

403.description: Undeclared action or disabled capability blocked by server policy

404.description: Existing student not found in tutor workspace

TutorPilotBearerToken.description: Generate a revocable personal token (tp_ext_...) inside TutorPilot -> Settings -> Connect External AI.

action.description: Strictly one of the 5 allowlisted actions across the 3 declared capabilities.

studentNameOrId.description: Existing student's name or ID (required for log_after_class_update, schedule_lesson, cancel_lesson).

lastTaught.description: For log_after_class_update: concise summary of what was just taught in today's class.

nextToTeach.description: For log_after_class_update: concise topic or next sequential lesson to teach in the next class.

homeworkTask.description: Optional homework assignment to record for the student.

appendNote.description: Optional short lesson recap note appended to the student's notes.

markTodayCompleted.description: When logging lastTaught, automatically mark today's matching scheduled class as completed.

date.description: For schedule_lesson or cancel_lesson: target date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timeSlot.description: For schedule_lesson: class time e.g. '4:30 PM'.

topic.description: For schedule_lesson (optional lesson topic) or get_app_guide (optional feature topic).

repeatWeekly.description: For schedule_lesson: whether this class repeats weekly.

sessionId.description: Optional specific session ID for cancel_lesson.
